description: Start or continue a person's conversational Selfie interview. Returns the question groupings (Performer's original questions: formal learning, work, life history and the reflective topics), their purposes, the seven Selfie groupings, progress, where to continue, what survives a chat ending, and the package. No document is needed. Send the person's package from an earlier chat to continue it; without one a new interview begins.

package.description: The package the last GoldSeam Selfie answer returned (goldribbon_package_v1 with its selfie_interview part). Keep it for the person and send it back whole; GoldSeam keeps no copy.

name: make_my_selfie
